cleanup.status: final artifacts retained; stale partial formal directories removed after report validation

formal_comparison.comparison_note: Prediction bytes, quality dictionaries, non-time run summaries, and normalized metric traces are compared per paired key; measured time fields are intentionally excluded from equality.
formal_comparison.timing_scope: per-input / per-condition arithmetic means over 85 inputs; CPU=user+system; RSS=max_rss_kb

memory_caveat.observed_note: The full fresh run shows per-condition RSS changes of +0.80%, +2.73%, +1.79%, and +2.46% (overall mean +0.401 MiB, +2.01%); max RSS is a process-level measurement and should not be read as an isolated allocation measurement.
memory_caveat.range: dense/triangular tables are enabled only for lengths 64..1024; shorter/longer inputs use sparse fallback

theoretical_at_length_1024.next_valid_uint16_square: about 2 MiB when profile position filtering is active
theoretical_at_length_1024.profile_pair_score_dense_float_square: about 4.0 MiB when the profile wrapper path is active

energy_caches.finding: Three energy caches did not produce a reliable end-to-end gain: BPP-only LPC 10.107 s versus cache 10.120 s; LPV 10.387 s versus 10.367 s (noise), with approximately +3.5 MiB RSS.
energy_caches.reason: No clear speed gain and higher memory.

inline_callback_cache.finding: The inline callback cache was kept outside the final candidate scope; no complete formal measurement was recorded.
inline_callback_cache.reason: Evaluation incomplete; no performance claim is made.

nalpha_nbeta_separate_tables.finding: BPP-only versus baseline was exact 6/6 with mean wall change -0.99% and mean RSS +2.38%; the Nalpha+Nbeta variant versus combined was exact 6/6 but added mean RSS +5.91%.
nalpha_nbeta_separate_tables.reason: The adopted implementation uses one triangular pointer lookup shared by N-state alpha/beta access, avoiding duplicated N-table storage.

scope: LinearFold medium-length lookup and base-pair probability accumulation

source.round4_delta: The final round changes are in LinFold lookup/BPP storage; profile.h remains the frozen baseline header.
